channel.title: A Player Mode
channel.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team: it builds your plan, has it ready every morning and shrinks bad days, so your brain stops holding everything. Daily and weekly planning help for planners and ADHD-routine seekers.

item.title: Weekly Planner for Mind, Body and Spirit Goals, Covered Without You Deciding
item.description: Planning work, workouts, sleep, faith and family by hand every week is a job in itself. A Player Mode starts every plan with Mind, Body and Spirit on by default and sorts anything else you care about into one of the three. It picks the workout, protects your sleep and makes room for family and faith, at a safe pace, without you guarding the time.

item.title: ADHD Routine for Bad Days: A Minimum Day With No Catch-Up and No Guilt
item.description: Routines break the day you miss one. In A Player Mode, Recovery mode gives you a minimum day after a bad day or in a low season: no catch-up, no guilt. Executive Review organizes the 3 to 7 things already in your head without adding new ones, and Deep Work protects one focus block. One tap, no paragraphs about how you feel. A planning app, not medical advice.

item.title: ADHD Morning Routine Help: Max 5 Physical Steps, Then the One Task That Matters
item.description: When starting is the hard part, a plan you have to build yourself is one more task. A Player Mode has your morning order ready at the time you set: feet to the floor, 1 minute of breathing, a glass of water, then your highest-leverage step. Bad days shrink automatically: no catch-up, no guilt. A planning app, not medical advice or treatment.

item.title: Weekly Planning Without Overplanning: A Working Plan in About 3 Minutes
item.description: Stop designing planners you never use. Tap through easy questions, about 3 minutes to a working plan, no essays. A Player Mode builds your one priority, your minimum day, your rules and your first 7 days, and you approve each piece. Then every morning the plan arrives on its own: one priority, a short start, then the day.

item.title: Daily Planner App That Plans Your Day for You: Founding 100 at $9.99/month
item.description: A Player Mode is a planning app with a five-role executive team. Answer easy taps for about 3 minutes and it builds your plan, then has it ready every morning: one priority, a short start, then the day. The first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at $9.99/month for as long as they stay subscribed. No free trial; cancel any time.
